name: Vanguard
description: A balanced frontline fighter with reliable firepower.

name: Charger
description: A high-speed attacker that trades durability for mobility.

name: Shield Guard
description: A durable defender that holds the frontline.

name: Exploder
description: Explodes on death, damaging nearby enemy fighters.

name: Sniper
description: A high-damage single-shot fighter with extreme range.

name: Laser Link
description: Targets the farthest enemy fighter within its attack range.

name: Scattershot
description: Fires three spread shots at close range.

name: Twin Formation
description: Deploys two balanced fighters in a compact formation.

name: Blast Module
description: Adds explosive shots to adjacent fighters.

name: Rapid Cannon
description: Adds rapid straight shots to adjacent fighters.

name: Wave Emitter
description: Adds weaving wave shots to adjacent fighters.

name: Laser Link Module
description: Fires lasers at up to 3 farthest linked allies every 3 seconds.

name: Arc Launcher
description: Adds arcing shots to adjacent fighters.

name: Arc Coil
description: Adds chain-lightning shots to adjacent fighters.
